_about: Level-name corrections for three TotalSegmentator people of the rare-class render root (/rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/rare_class/totalsegmentator_drr), read by tools/make_context_crops.py --name-remap and SchwingNet/tools/fig6_sets.py. That root was relabelled from the VERIDAH ctd (the scrambled SPINEPS ids were repaired; census job 40424679: 933 frames, 12 people, 0 non-monotonic name runs), so its NAMES are VERIDAH's. SchwingNet/results/spineps_ids/TS12_VERIFY.md (independent count from SPINEPS instances and CT rib components, no VERIDAH name) and SchwingNet/results/rare_class/ts12_subtype_override.json disagree with VERIDAH on three people. The frozen reference convention (SchwingNet/LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md s4: L6 = six rib-free vertebrae above the sacrum, T13 = thirteen rib-bearing vertebrae) follows the verification, so the names are rewritten here to it. No radiologist has read any of the three.

why.ts_s1178: VERIDAH skipped T12: the 12th ribs meet the vertebra VERIDAH calls L1, and its ctd has no T12, so VERIDAH's L1..L6 are T12, L1..L5. Verified subtype: none (24 presacral).
why.ts_s1088: 12 rib pairs; the 20th vertebra (VERIDAH 'T13') has no rib on either side. Under the rib convention it is L1 and the spine carries six lumbar-type vertebrae: VERIDAH's T13, L1..L5 are L1..L6. Verified subtype: L6.
why.ts_s1123: As s1088: no articulating rib on the 20th vertebra; VERIDAH's T13, L1..L5 are L1..L6. Verified subtype: L6.
